name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: A file as a frame of cells that never change: media, name (the extension stays in view) and detail, one action. Uploading fills the bottom keyline; processing runs the pending segment; error stops the bar in red and floods the media cell with !; an upload that lands floods it yellow with a tick for 900ms. layout="cell" makes it a cell of a Bubble.
whenToUse: Use it to show a file as a row, with upload progress, failure and retry. In a chat message, put it in a Bubble as a cell.

props.name: layout
props.description: control (default): its own frame. cell: a cell of the Bubble it sits in.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100 while uploading; on error, where it stopped.

props.name: size
props.description: default: one row. compact: a smaller row for a composer. tile: media above the name (thumbnails).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

parts.name: AttachmentActions
parts.description: The action cell(s), each a square key on a seam (cancel, retry, open, remove). Name each button. Keep one action in every state of a sent file, so the frame keeps its width while the action changes.

parts.name: AttachmentDescription
parts.description: Size and type in the Code voice; while uploading it adds the percentage, on error it is the reason (announced). It never widens the frame: the name sets the width, and a long reason wraps.

parts.name: AttachmentMedia
parts.description: The media cell: a 16px glyph, or an (a thumbnail; give it alt="" when the name says what it is). It is also where the outcome lands: it floods red with ! on failure, and yellow with a tick when an upload completes.

parts.name: AttachmentTitle
parts.description: The file name; a long name keeps its extension in view (end-truncation would hide it). Its direction follows its own text (a Latin name stays "CMR.pdf" in an RTL page).

parts.name: AttachmentTrigger
parts.description: Makes the whole frame open the file: an overlay button or link (render={<a href=…/>}) under the actions. Name it.
